scheduling_method: latest feasible ON and earliest feasible OFF under interpolated daylight and astronomical constraints
scenario_interpretation: Sensitivity combinations, not confidence intervals or measured site attenuation.
sunset_guard: ON no later than sunset rounded down to a minute
sunrise_guard: OFF no earlier than sunrise rounded up to a minute
twilight_treatment: Station-based radiation proxy cannot resolve true twilight lux; sunset/sunrise guards prevent relying on that uncertainty overnight.
timing_precision: One-minute decision resolution through shape-preserving interpolation of 15-minute predictions; this is not measured one-minute accuracy.
manual_comparison: Noon-to-noon schedule reconstruction: presume ON continuously between observed endpoints and OFF elsewhere.
rate_status: Tariff and carbon factor are unset in project_config; add documented local factors to calculate monetary or carbon results.
